# The garden shed

We built the shed in the back corner of the garden in April. It stands on six
concrete pillars because the ground there stays wet until June. The walls are
untreated larch boards, the roof is covered with green bitumen shingles, and the
door faces south so the morning sun dries it. The padlock code is 4711.

Inside, the left wall holds the long tools on hooks: two spades, the rake, the
hoe and the edge cutter. The petrol for the lawnmower stays in a red metal can on
the floor, never on the shelf, and the mower itself is serviced every March at
the shop in Talstraße.

The compost bins are behind the shed, three wooden boxes side by side. Fresh
cuttings and kitchen scraps go into the left box, the middle one is turned every
six weeks, and the right one holds finished compost for the vegetable beds. No
cooked food, meat or citrus peel goes in, or the rats come back.
